name: Behringer CZ-1 MINI
description: Behringer CZ-1 MINI phase distortion synthesizer: every controller of its manual's MIDI table, with the values it prints.

sources.title: CZ-1 MINI Manual
sources.notes: MIDI controller table (pages 57, 58, 59) read by tools/profiles/behringer/read-behringer-cc.mjs from Manual_BE_0718-ACK_CZ-1-MINI_WW.pdf (sha256 d33139a5ca31b6313a46cff3d37936cb716fac25b0020e448d5b1134af250686), https://cdn-media.empowertribe.com/c188d499282940259ac0587832796ccb/Manual_BE_0718-ACK_CZ-1-MINI_WW.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/behringer/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/behringer/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI controller table, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Ranges are as printed (`0 - 99`): the guide does not say whether a range is the controller's values or what the panel shows for them.
Rows the guide prints wrongly, given by the layout: CC 14 (printed DCO WF2, between DCO 1 WF1 and DCO 1 DCW: DCO 1 WF2).
Left out, the wheels, pedals, bank select, NRPN and RPN controllers and the channel mode messages: CC 0 Bank Select, CC 1 Mod Wheel.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its MIDI settings allow
